$comment: What every setting in this section does, its type and allowed values; defaults are in config.json beside this file. See scripts/pipeline/lib/settings.mjs.

featureVerification.evidence.manifest.does: Where a recorded test run writes its manifest of videos and steps.
featureVerification.evidence.manifest.allowed: a path relative to the repository

featureVerification.precheck.runTests.does: Runs the written tests before the test automation verifier sees them.

featureVerification.precheck.fix.does: Auto-fix commands by file extension (`{files}`), run on written files before the checks.

featureVerification.precheck.lint.does: Lint commands by file extension (`{files}`); a failure goes back to the writer before any verifier runs.

featureVerification.precheck.scenarioFil.does: The file name of a test data scenario.

featureVerification.precheck.validateSce.does: A command that validates a written scenario.

featureVerification.precheck.testRunners.does: How written tests are run and discovered ([test runners](ai-pipeline/feature-verification.md)); `null`: the language packs' runners.
featureVerification.precheck.testRunners.allowed: runner objects, or a pack's runner names such as `dotnet/xunit`

featureVerification.precheck.automationN.does: Extra lines for the test writer's task.

featureVerification.precheck.lintExclude.does: Files the lint and fix commands never read.

featureVerification.precheck.requireStac.does: Fails a test run whose end-to-end runner found no running app stack.

featureVerification.precheck.requireUiEv.does: Fails a passing UI test run that recorded no evidence of the screens it tested.

featureVerification.precheck.runFullProj.does: Runs a test project in full when none of the ticket's tests could be selected in it.

featureVerification.precheck.fullProject.does: Runs the touched test projects in full in every round, not only the last.

featureVerification.categories.plan.does: The gap categories a test plan verifier may report.

featureVerification.categories.automatio.does: The gap categories a test automation verifier may report.

featureVerification.categories.sadPathSu.does: The subtypes of a missing sad path.

featureVerification.timeoutsSec.plan.does: The normal time the test planner may take.

featureVerification.timeoutsSec.automati.does: The normal time the test writer may take.

featureVerification.timeoutsSec.verifier.does: The normal time a test plan or test automation verifier may take.

featureVerification.timeoutsSec.lessons.does: The normal time the lessons writer may take.

featureVerification.timeoutsSec.tests.does: The normal time a test run may take.

featureVerification.slots.enabled.does: Lets a test run borrow its own copy of the app instead of sharing the main one.

featureVerification.plansDir.does: The folder where test plans are written, one folder per ticket.
featureVerification.plansDir.allowed: a folder relative to the repository

featureVerification.slotWaitSec.does: How long a test run waits for a free copy of the app.

featureVerification.enabled.does: Runs the automatic test planning and test writing for each ticket.

testPlan.maxCouncilRounds.does: How many rounds the test plan council gets before the stage escalates to a person (any council size).

testPlan.councilPassScore.does: The score every blocking member of the test plan council must give, with no blocking finding standing, for it to pass (any council size).

testPlan.councilMembers.does: How many counted members sit on the test plan council, beside the fixed clean-code seat (`null`: `council.members`).

testPlan.orchestrator.model.does: The `models.pool` entry the test plan stage orchestrator runs on (`null`: `orchestrator.model`).

testPlan.orchestrator.effort.does: The test plan stage orchestrator's reasoning effort (`null`: `orchestrator.effort`, else its entry's).

testPlan.councilIntercom.does: The test plan council's own discussion settings, over `council.intercom` (a council of one holds no discussion).

testAutomation.maxCouncilRounds.does: How many rounds the test automation council gets before the stage escalates to a person (any council size).

testAutomation.councilPassScore.does: The score every blocking member of the test automation council must give, with no blocking finding standing, for it to pass (any council size).

testAutomation.councilMembers.does: How many counted members sit on the test automation council, beside the fixed clean-code seat (`null`: `council.members`).

testAutomation.orchestrator.model.does: The `models.pool` entry the test automation stage orchestrator runs on (`null`: `orchestrator.model`).

testAutomation.orchestrator.effort.does: The test automation stage orchestrator's reasoning effort (`null`: `orchestrator.effort`, else its entry's).

testAutomation.councilIntercom.does: The test automation council's own discussion settings, over `council.intercom` (a council of one holds no discussion).
